envelope.description: Define source-light locator, manifest and historical-reader contracts

body.title: Define source-light locator, manifest and historical-reader contracts
body.summary: Introduce versioned exact selected-change locators and attempt baseline-workspace manifests, remove durable aggregate source bodies from new prepared state, and define cold requalification or explicit rejection for historical eager-derived records.
acceptanceChecks: New code-review durable state stores immutable commit/parent/object identities, exact file/range/block locators and sealed workspace metadata, never aggregate source bodies.
Decoders reject unknown or ambiguous required versions; supported historical records cannot silently become trusted source authority and are either cold-requalified or explicitly rejected.
Design review latest-document contracts and existing compact runtime/history/publication contracts remain unchanged.

tests.name: Source-light locator/manifest codecs: ordered Unicode paths, add/delete/rename/replacement/merge/binary metadata, object and parent identities, version rejection, tamper/cross-attempt detection, and source-body absence.
